title: Act on Promotion of Linkage and Utilization of National Knowledge Information
title_original: 국가지식정보 연계 및 활용 촉진에 관한 법률
full_text:
Chapter 1 General Provisions

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to enhance the capacity of the people to create and utilize knowledge assets and contribute to strengthening national competitiveness by providing for matters necessary to promote the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information so that the people may freely and conveniently use national knowledge information.

Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in this Act shall be defined as follows:
1. "National knowledge information" means digitized information with value for nationwide use for the purposes of utilizing knowledge and education, or information recognized as requiring digitization, among information concerning science and technology, education and academic affairs, culture and the arts, society and the economy, administration, and other fields that is produced, held, or managed by national agencies, local governments, and public institutions under Article 2, subparagraph 16 of the Framework Act on Intelligent Informatization (hereinafter referred to as "national agencies, etc."), which has been designated by the National Knowledge Information Committee pursuant to Article 9.
2. "Digitization" means converting information expressed by means other than optical or electronic means into electronic form so as to enhance its utility for preservation and use.
3. "Integrated platform" means a system that integrates and links national knowledge information and provides it to the people through information and communications networks.

Article 3 (Basic Principles)
When promoting the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information, national agencies, etc. shall give priority consideration to the following basic principles:
1. To continuously manage and develop national knowledge information so that the people may freely use it.
2. To provide the people with fair opportunities to use national knowledge information.
3. To strengthen cooperation with the private sector to promote the utilization of national knowledge information.
4. Not to unfairly discriminate against any particular technology or service when managing and utilizing national knowledge information.
5. Not to infringe the rights of other persons, including intellectual property rights, when utilizing national knowledge information.

Article 4 (Responsibilities of the State and Local Governments)
The State and local governments shall establish appropriate policies to promote the efficient linkage and utilization of national knowledge information.

Article 5 (Relationship to Other Acts)
(1) When other Acts relating to the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information are enacted or amended, efforts shall be made to ensure that they conform to the purpose and basic principles of this Act.
(2) Except as otherwise specifically provided in other Acts, the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information shall be governed by this Act.

Chapter 2 Establishment of Policies on National Knowledge Information and Implementation Framework

Article 6 (Establishment and Implementation of Master Plan)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT shall establish and implement a master plan for the promotion of the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information (hereinafter referred to as the "master plan") every three years.
(2) The master plan shall include the following matters:
1. Matters concerning the basic direction and medium- and long-term development direction for the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information.
2. Matters concerning the designation, linkage, and utilization of national knowledge information.
3. Matters concerning the improvement of relevant statutes, regulations, and systems to promote the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information.
4. Matters concerning securing and managing financial resources and securing personnel necessary for implementing policies on national knowledge information.
5. Matters concerning the operational results and performance management of national knowledge information.
6. Other matters necessary to promote the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information.
(3) When establishing the master plan pursuant to paragraph (1), the Minister of Science and ICT shall have the plan deliberated and resolved upon by the National Knowledge Information Committee under Article 8. The same shall apply when revising the master plan.
(4) When establishing action plans for an intelligent information society under Article 7 of the Framework Act on Intelligent Informatization and implementation plans under Article 8 of the Act on Promotion of the Provision and Use of Public Data, the heads of national agencies, etc. shall ensure that the contents of the master plan are reflected therein.
(5) Other matters necessary for the establishment and implementation of the master plan shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 7 (Cooperation of Relevant Agencies)
Where necessary for the establishment and implementation of the master plan, the Minister of Science and ICT may request cooperation from the heads of national agencies, etc. (excluding the National Assembly, courts, the Constitutional Court, and the National Election Commission). In such cases, the heads of national agencies, etc. who have received a request for cooperation shall comply with the request unless there is a special reason not to do so.

Article 8 (National Knowledge Information Committee)
(1) A National Knowledge Information Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee") shall be established under the Minister of Science and ICT to deliberate on and coordinate policies on national knowledge information.
(2) The Committee shall be composed of no more than 20 members, including one chairperson.
(3) The Minister of Science and ICT shall serve as chairperson, and the following persons shall serve as members. In such cases, for an agency with more than one vice minister, the vice minister designated by the head of that agency shall serve as a member. <Amended 2025.10.1>
1. Officials at the vice-ministerial level of relevant central administrative agencies prescribed by Presidential Decree, such as the Vice Minister of Education, the Vice Minister of the Interior and Safety, the Vice Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, and the Vice Minister of Planning and Budget.
2. Persons commissioned by the Minister of Science and ICT from among persons with extensive expert knowledge and experience concerning the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information.
(4) The term of office of a member shall be two years, and a member may serve only one consecutive additional term. However, the term of office of a member newly commissioned due to the resignation of a member or other such reason shall be the remainder of the predecessor's term of office.
(5) Other matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Committee shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 9 (Functions of the Committee)
(1) The Committee shall deliberate and adopt resolutions on the following matters:
1. Matters concerning the formulation and amendment of the master plan;
2. Matters concerning improvements to statutes and regulations, systems, and policies relating to national knowledge information;
3. Matters concerning the designation of national knowledge information;
4. Matters concerning inspection of the status of utilization of national knowledge information;
5. Matters concerning consultation and coordination among national agencies, etc., and mediation of disputes regarding the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information;
6. Other matters that the chairperson deems necessary in connection with the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information.
(2) Where the Committee has deliberated and adopted a resolution on a matter under paragraph (1), subparagraph 2, it may recommend improvements to the relevant institutions.

Article 10 (Guidelines for Management of National Knowledge Information)
The Minister of Science and ICT shall establish and publicly notify guidelines for the management of national knowledge information to promote the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information.

Article 11 (Designation of a Dedicated Institution, Etc.)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT may designate the National Information Society Agency under Article 12 of the Framework Act on Intelligent Informatization as a dedicated institution (hereinafter referred to as the "dedicated institution") to comprehensively and efficiently carry out the following matters:
1. Support for affairs concerning the promotion of linkage and utilization of national knowledge information;
2. Support for affairs necessary for the formulation and implementation of the master plan;
3. Support for the establishment and operation of the integrated platform;
4. Other affairs prescribed by Presidential Decree to promote the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information.
(2) The Minister of Science and ICT may contribute funds to the dedicated institution to cover the costs necessary to carry out the matters set out in the subparagraphs of paragraph (1).
(3) Other matters necessary for the designation and operation of the dedicated institution and other relevant matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 12 (Designation and Operation of Knowledge Information Centers, Etc.)
(1) To efficiently link and utilize national knowledge information, the Minister of Science and ICT may, in consultation with the heads of relevant central administrative agencies, designate specialized institutions in each field of national knowledge information as Knowledge Information Centers and have them link and utilize national knowledge information in their respective fields.
(2) A Knowledge Information Center designated under paragraph (1) (hereinafter referred to as a "Knowledge Information Center") shall take the necessary measures to ensure that national knowledge information can be utilized on the integrated platform.
(3) The Government may provide Knowledge Information Centers with budgetary and other necessary support for the collection and management of national knowledge information and its linkage to the integrated platform.
(4) Where necessary to promote the provision and use of national knowledge information, the Minister of Science and ICT may establish and operate a consultative body with relevant institutions, including Knowledge Information Centers.
(5) Other matters necessary for the designation and operation of Knowledge Information Centers, the formation and operation of the consultative body, and other relevant matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Chapter 3 Linkage and Utilization of National Knowledge Information

Article 13 (Designation and Utilization of National Knowledge Information to Be Linked to the Integrated Platform)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT may, in consultation with the heads of national agencies, etc., designate national knowledge information to be linked to the integrated platform.
(2) The heads of national agencies, etc. holding national knowledge information designated under paragraph (1) shall formulate plans concerning the digitization of national knowledge information, its linkage to and utilization through the integrated platform, and other relevant matters, and submit those plans to the Minister of Science and ICT.
(3) The criteria and procedures for the designation of national knowledge information to be linked to the integrated platform under paragraph (1), and matters necessary for the formulation of plans under paragraph (2), shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 14 (Establishment and Operation of the Integrated Platform, Etc.)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT shall establish and operate an integrated platform to efficiently link and utilize national knowledge information.
(2) The Minister of Science and ICT may request cooperation necessary for the establishment and operation of the integrated platform from the heads of national agencies, etc. In such cases, the heads of national agencies, etc. receiving the request shall comply unless there are special reasons not to do so.
(3) The Minister of Science and ICT shall endeavor to develop new technologies and services so that citizens can conveniently use national knowledge information through the integrated platform.
(4) Other matters necessary for the establishment and operation of the integrated platform and other relevant matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 15 (Surveys of Current Status)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT may conduct surveys of the status of holdings of national knowledge information, the status of linkage to the integrated platform, and other relevant matters, to efficiently implement policies for promoting the provision and use of national knowledge information.
(2) For the surveys of current status under paragraph (1), the Minister of Science and ICT may request national agencies, etc. (excluding the National Assembly, courts, the Constitutional Court, and the National Election Commission) to submit necessary materials or provide support. In such cases, national agencies, etc. receiving the request shall comply unless there are special reasons not to do so.
(3) Matters necessary for the surveys of current status under paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 16 (Provision of and Support for National Knowledge Information)
(1) National agencies, etc. shall adopt measures necessary to guarantee citizens' freedom to access and use national knowledge information.
(2) Where necessary to promote the use of national knowledge information, the Government may, within budgetary limits, provide support for all or part of the costs necessary to use national knowledge information to citizens whose use of such information is restricted for economic reasons.

Article 17 (Standardization of National Knowledge Information)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT shall promote standardization for the production, linkage, and efficient utilization of national knowledge information. However, where Korean Industrial Standards have been established under the Industrial Standardization Act, those standards shall be followed.
(2) Other matters relating to the standardization of national knowledge information shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 18 (Cooperation with the Private Sector)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT may provide national knowledge information through private business operators, associations of private business operators, and other entities to promote the use of national knowledge information.
(2) To link knowledge information held by the private sector that has value for preservation and use to the integrated platform, the Minister of Science and ICT may cooperate with private business operators, associations of private business operators, and other entities holding such information.
(3) Matters necessary for the provision of national knowledge information under paragraph (1), the linkage of private knowledge information to the integrated platform under paragraph (2), and other relevant matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

CHAPTER 4 SUPPLEMENTARY PROVISIONS

Article 19 (Support for the Linkage and Utilization of National Knowledge Information)
The Government may provide national agencies, etc. with necessary administrative, technical, and financial support to promote the efficient linkage and utilization of national knowledge information, and may provide financial assistance, within budgetary limits, for the costs of digitization of national knowledge information.

Article 20 (Coordination of Consultations among National Agencies, Etc.)
(1) Where consultation with other national agencies, etc. concerning the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information has not been completed and coordination is necessary, the head of a national agency, etc. may request that the Committee resolve the differences of opinion.
(2) Upon receiving a request for coordination of differences of opinion under paragraph (1), the Committee shall review the request and notify the heads of the relevant national agencies, etc. of the results of its coordination. In such cases, the heads of national agencies, etc. notified of the coordination results shall comply with them.

Article 21 (Mediation of Disputes)
(1) A party to a dispute concerning the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information, such as a private business operator or an organization of private business operators, may request mediation by the Committee: Provided, That this shall not apply where other Acts, such as the Personal Information Protection Act or the Copyright Act, contain special provisions.
(2) Matters necessary concerning the procedures, methods, etc. for mediation under the main clause of paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 22 (Inspection of National Knowledge Information)
(1) Where necessary, the Minister of Science and ICT may inspect the actual state of the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information at national agencies, etc. (excluding the National Assembly, courts, the Constitutional Court, and the National Election Commission).
(2) The Minister of Science and ICT shall report the results of an inspection under paragraph (1) to the Committee and notify the heads of national agencies, etc. of those results.
(3) Other matters necessary for inspecting the actual state of the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 23 (Education and Awards)
(1) The Minister of Science and ICT may undertake education, public outreach, etc. to raise public awareness of national knowledge information and encourage its use.
(2) The Government may select and grant awards to persons, organizations, etc. that have made outstanding contributions to the linkage and utilization of national knowledge information.

Article 24 (Prohibition of Disadvantageous Measures, Etc.)
Public officials, officers, and employees of national agencies, etc., and officers and employees of private business operators and organizations of private business operators, etc. shall not, in the absence of willful misconduct or gross negligence, be subjected to any disadvantage, including disciplinary measures, or discrimination in working conditions on the grounds of lawfully providing national knowledge information under this Act.

ADDENDA <Act No. 18197, June 8, 2021>

This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 21065, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Effective Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That, among the Acts amended pursuant to Article 7 of these Addenda, the portions amending Acts promulgated before this Act enters into force but whose effective dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of those Acts, and the amended provisions in the following subparagraphs shall enter into force on the dates specified therein:

1. The amended provisions in the following items shall enter into force on January 2, 2026: Provided, That, among the Acts amended pursuant to Article 7 of these Addenda (limited to the portions related to the amended provisions in items (a) and (b)), the portions amending Acts promulgated before the effective date under the main clause but whose effective date under the main clause has not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of those Acts:

   (a) The amended provisions of Article 19 (4), Article 23, Article 29 (1) 1, and Article 30;

   (b) The amended provisions of Article 12 (2), Article 19 (3), Article 22, and the proviso to Article 29 (2) (limited to the portions concerning the Minister of Finance and Economy and the Ministry of Finance and Economy);

   (c) The Acts amended pursuant to Article 7 of these Addenda (limited to the portions related to the amended provisions in items (a) and (b)).

2. Omitted.

Articles 2 through 6: Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Acts)
(1) through (81): Omitted.

(82) The Act on Promotion of Linkage and Utilization of National Knowledge Information shall be amended as follows:

In Article 8 (3) 1, "Vice Minister of Economy and Finance, Vice Minister of Education, Vice Minister of the Interior and Safety, Vice Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism" shall be replaced with "Vice Minister of Education, Vice Minister of the Interior and Safety, Vice Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, Vice Minister of Planning and Budget".

(83) through (626): Omitted.

Article 8: Omitted.
